introduction: Explore Valhingen’s ruined cave city and meet its undead wizard. Prepare his three-material commission while following leads about the city’s curse,its libraries,the mine,the cold lake and meaningful restitution.
orientation: Learn an admitted route into Valhingen and back. The current Surface mine entrances and Underdark tunnel lead to different parts of the city.
Seek the undead wizard in Valhingen’s magic shop. His commission asks for the exact mystic tablet,Bel’s still-beating heart and Orb of Unmaking together.
Carry one exact copy of each requested material loose in your inventory. Recovered or supplied copies fit without your own boss victories or personal route history.
The tablet’s clue suggests further requirements,but the wizard’s current exchange takes the three listed materials. The journal records that exact accepted exchange.
Finding an intended source for the mystic tablet remains a lead to investigate. The journal does not promise a new source or automatic replenishment.
Bel’s heart and the Orb of Unmaking also belong to other commissions. Choose which original exchange to complete;one spent set does not finish every request.
Preparing the three materials is different from completing the accepted exchange. Its receipt remains recorded after those materials are spent.
Receiving the Intelligence scroll and gaining a useful intelligence benefit are separate milestones. The journal does not yet record an admitted useful effect from the scroll.

The wizard also offers epic intelligence training under its own rules. Listing a lesson or hearing an ambient message does not record learning;these purchases are currently unavailable while accounting is active.
Indigo,aqua,bone and grey mine keys serve different doors. Finding a key,opening the correct door and making a safe passage are separate steps.
Akabar’s history and Ordack’s library suggest knowledge and restitution stories. The journal has no agreed reform or research task for them yet.
The undead households,children and forced knights suggest stories about the curse and useful peace. Ordinary combat or removing a creature does not itself record helping a victim.
Jurtrem and Dranum have distinct encounters and equipment. Their defeat,loot recovery and an intentional restitution or restoration outcome are separate stories.
The mine and cold lake offer different routes and risks. The boat keeper’s skiff,an actual purchase and a successful journey with a safe return are different milestones.
A memory of New Cave city has a commission with an ambassador elsewhere. The rune stone has its own epic rules;these outcomes remain separate from the wizard’s exchange.

stories.title: The wizard’s three-material commission
stories.summary: Bring the exact mystic tablet,Bel’s heart and Orb of Unmaking together to the wizard for an Intelligence scroll. Recovered or supplied copies fit. Useful scroll benefits and epic training remain separate stories.
